attribution.zh: Agent 方法论文卡（SkillHub distill）。站点不跑 sklearn；完整流程见 Skills.md。
attribution.en: Agent methodology recipe cards (SkillHub distill). No sklearn in the browser — full workflows in Skills.md.

cards.titleZh: 滚动训练 → Walk-forward 信号
cards.bodyZh: 用 ml-strategy 技能：特征工程 → 滚动 sklearn 训练 → 禁未来函数的样本外信号。站点 Strategy Lab 用 ml_lite 滞后符号作教育 distill；完整 ML 训练留在 Agent CLI。
cards.bodyEn: Use the ml-strategy skill: features → rolling sklearn fit → no-lookahead OOS signals. Strategy Lab exposes ml_lite lag-sign as an educational distill; full ML training stays in the Agent CLI.

cards.titleZh: 策略生成 → 回测 → 调参
cards.bodyZh: 策略生成与优化技能：起草规则、参数网格与评估清单。把候选策略映射到 Lab 的 MA/RSI/形态，再用纸盘练习次日开盘成交。
cards.bodyEn: Strategy-generate skill: draft rules, grids, and an evaluation checklist. Map candidates onto Lab MA/RSI/pattern strategies, then practice next-open fills on Paper.

cards.titleZh: 因子 IC → TopN 组合
cards.bodyZh: 因子研究 / 多因子选股技能指导横截面打分。站点 Factor Board 用 OHLC 代理（动量·低波·ADV·质量）展示排名，非实时基本面。
cards.bodyEn: Factor-research / multi-factor skills guide cross-section scoring. The Factor Board shows OHLC-proxy ranks (momentum · low-vol · ADV · quality), not live fundamentals.

cards.titleZh: RSI 均值回归 Lab 预设
cards.bodyZh: 在 Strategy Lab 打开 RSI 策略，观察超买超卖阈值与次日开盘成交；对照固定 bps 与 √冲击成本。
cards.bodyEn: Open the RSI strategy in Strategy Lab; inspect OS/OB thresholds under next-open fills; contrast fixed vs √-impact costs.

cards.bodyZh: K 线形态技能的 15 种形态在信号看板聚合为共振分。把偏多标的加入清单或批量纸盘，仍按次日开盘。
cards.bodyEn: Fifteen candlestick patterns feed the signal-board confluence score. Promote bullish names to checklist/Paper — still next-open only.

cards.bodyZh: 执行模型技能：在纸盘执行台选 TWAP 或 VWAP，切片 Materialize 写入日记，再导出券商清单。
cards.bodyEn: Execution-model skill: on Paper exec desk pick TWAP or VWAP, materialize slices into the journal, then export the broker checklist.

cards.titleZh: 公告事件桶 → 委员会
cards.bodyZh: 公告搜索技能 bake 后，事件桶进入委员会新闻角色证据。把偏多共识 Promote 到纸盘练习，不要把共识当成交许可。
cards.bodyEn: After announcement-search bake, event buckets feed Committee news-role evidence. Promote bullish consensus to Paper practice — consensus ≠ trade permission.

cards.bodyZh: 模拟炒股 distill：本地限价练习后导入纸盘，用对账面板核对现金与持仓差；站点不连 THS 交易 API。
cards.bodyEn: Sim-trading distill: after local limit practice, import into Paper and reconcile cash/qty deltas — site never calls THS trade APIs.
